ContextDocumentRequest.description: When present in ArchitectureRequest.documents[], name, contentType, and content are required by FluentValidation (empty arrays are allowed on the parent request).

headlineSavingsScopeDescription.default: Single-tenant portfolio headline: disposition-aware open + needs-evidence estimated USD from the latest committed run per system (cap 200). Excludes remediated, waived, deferred, and accepted-risk findings.

trailing30DayActivityScopeDescription.default: Trailing 30-day UTC activity: distinct finding IDs resolved via review trail or discovered on committed runs. Counts only — not USD savings.
